guidance_rules: Never call these conversations 'terapia', 'psicoterapia' or 'atendimento psicológico', in any language; in Brazil psychotherapy and psychological diagnosis are reserved to CRP-registered psychologists (Lei 4.119/1962).

BR.notes: Persist: specific, highlighted consent (LGPD Art. 11, I) plus highlighted consent to the US transfer (Art. 33, VIII) or ANPD SCCs (mandatory form since 23 Aug 2025); publish a Portuguese transfer page (Res. 19/2024). No sharing health data for commercial advantage (Art. 11 §4). Pending: AI bill PL 2.338/2023, Câmara vote after the Oct 2026 elections (health AI high risk). ECA Digital in force 17 Mar 2026; fine levels reported inconsistently. Backend: encarregado, RIPD, 3-business-day breach notice.

laws.citation: and Código Penal Art 208 (illegal practice of medicine)

laws.name: Ley 23.277 Ejercicio profesional de la psicología
laws.citation: as amended by Ley 27.553 Art 7

healthcare_rules: Do not call this chat a 'consulta médica' or 'teleasistencia', and never draft anything resembling a 'receta'; in Argentina teleassistance and prescriptions belong to licensed professionals on registered platforms (Ley 27.553).
guidance_rules: Do not describe these conversations as 'psicología', 'psicoterapia' or 'tratamiento psicológico'; Argentina reserves psychological practice to licensed psychologists (Ley 23.277).
AR.regulator: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP), Dirección Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales; Ministerio de Salud; ANMAT (medical devices)
AR.notes: Persist on the practitioner reading (DLA Piper) that express, documented consent covers sensitive data; the literal Law 25.326 Art. 7(2)-(3) lists no consent ground and bars files revealing sensitive data, so a residual risk remains: minimise, no health profiles. Transfers: US not adequate; express consent (Decree 1558/2001 Art. 12) plus model clauses. Bill 3397-D-2026 (filed 16 Jul 2026) would add 72h breach notice and extraterritorial reach. Reach over a foreign controller is not explicit today.

CO.name: Colombia

laws.name: Ley Estatutaria 1581 de 2012
laws.citation: Art 5 (health is sensitive), Art 6 (explicit authorization), Art 7 (minors), Art 26 (transfers)

laws.name: Resolución MinSalud 2654 de 2019 (telesalud y telemedicina)

laws.name: Ley 1090 de 2006 (profesión de psicología)
laws.citation: Arts 3, 6, 8 (illegal practice by non-psychologists)

laws.name: Decreto 1377 de 2013
laws.citation: Art 6 (sensitive data optional; express consent), Arts 24-25 (transmission contracts)

healthcare_rules: When giving health information, make clear you are an AI and that Clardentity is responsible for the service; Colombia's telehealth rules (Res. 2654/2019 Art. 12.2) require this when AI is used for health orientation.
guidance_rules: Do not evaluate or diagnose psychological problems or call this 'psicología' or 'terapia'; in Colombia that is illegal practice for anyone without a psychologist's tarjeta profesional (Ley 1090/2006).
CO.regulator: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC), Delegatura para la Protección de Datos Personales; INVIMA (medical devices)
CO.notes: Persist: explicit prior authorisation that flags health data as sensitive and optional (Law 1581 Art. 6; Decree 1377 Art. 6). The US is on the SIC adequate list (Circular 005/2017) per DLA Piper only (SIC site unreachable); express authorisation is the fallback. Vendors are 'transmisiones' needing Decree 1377 Art. 25 contracts. SIC applies the law to foreign platforms. Backend: Spanish data policy, AI impact assessment (Circular 002/2024), SIC breach report within 15 business days. AI bills unverified.

laws.name: Ley 29733 de Protección de Datos Personales
laws.citation: Art 2(5) (health is sensitive), Art 13.6 (written consent), Art 15 (transfers)

laws.name: Reglamento de la Ley 29733
laws.citation: Decreto Supremo 016-2024-JUS, in force 30 Mar 2025; Art 8 (sensitive consent), Art 21.2 (transfer filing), Arts 22-25 (minors)

laws.name: Reglamento de la Ley 31814 (AI)
laws.citation: Decreto Supremo 115-2025-PCM; Art 23 (prohibited uses), Art 24.1(i) (high-risk health AI), Art 25 (transparency)

laws.name: Ley 30421 Ley Marco de Telesalud and Reglamento DS 005-2021-SA
laws.citation: telesalud and teleorientación by health personnel of registered providers

healthcare_rules: Do not call this service telesalud, teleconsulta or teleorientación, or imply a health professional is answering; in Peru those are services of registered health providers (Ley 30421).

When a health conversation starts, say briefly that you are an AI giving general information and cannot screen, triage or diagnose; Peru's AI Regulation under Ley 31814 (Art. 25) requires this for health AI.
guidance_rules: Do not present these conversations as a psychological service; in Peru psychology requires registration with the Colegio de Psicólogos (Ley 28369).
Never use guilt, flattery or urgency to keep the person talking or to push a decision; Peru's AI Regulation under Ley 31814 (Art. 23.1(a)) bans AI that exploits emotional vulnerabilities.
PE.regulator: Autoridad Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales (ANPD), via the DGTAIPD (https://www.gob.pe/anpd); SGTD-PCM (AI); MINSA, DIGEMID (devices)
PE.notes: Persist: written consent for health data (Law 29733 Art. 13.6; DS 016-2024-JUS Art. 8) covering the US transfer, plus ANPD filing of the cross-border flow. Review: Healthcare may be high-risk AI under DS 115-2025-PCM Art. 24.1(i); health-sector duties apply from about 10 Sep 2026 (labelling, transparency, records, human oversight, impact assessment), and MYPE deadlines may not help a foreign company. Backend: Peru representative, database registration, 48h breach notice, DPO by size deadline.
